translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

content: Yegec yomoc masiki uba modacma heibesonga. Dawidingo yegec yofi heiec.
Ngic mong ye singyoac kpeu Kebungo ebiha wamima kopocsihaac ebic semeec, ye kenehagoc.
Ngic mong ye ngicngac ogofora memanganeyunuu KEBUNGO kopocsiha wau kpac andac deande nga ngic mong ye asuyau ikoc mong mi fede, ngic imoc ye kenehagoc.
Ni kopocsicna mi deficgema waba feu asoacnac kemma marai asoringa anenu mi wisickemanu kecbare sebina kpac ambeso anec. Wenac nasou wiac kerenga amma moronggeande, ni kucna ifi isoc kpac anec.
Ge marigango hadzing toforec merandzinukecnecac wenacngo kpeu bangec gbanggeande, kucna ifi isoc gbanggema kpac ambeso anec. Selac
Anu ni kopocsicna gearu deficgeai. Ni kopocsicna mi semema yofi deai, “Ni singyoac kpekefai, imoc KEBUARU deficgebade.” ifi deba geng kopocsicna wama ubamanganna meickena kpac anec. Selac
Anutuac enac tofoc tofohongic yeni ebic fingecyemmeu yeneng gearu numubisia. Numugec ebic kuneng me doku tunggbaungngo naric mi kpesereyunuude.
Ge neac sufu sufuama. Ebicngo memanubeso anu geng onggonnuna ebicngo naric mi memanganenuu geng sogac sogaiac aro kunengngo oronnunade. Selac
KEBUNGO deec, “Ge singga tinade, imoc edekpou anggemba, imoc modacbesena. Kicnango modacguma dederecgeyoac anggembade.
Becosic nga donggi yeni negen negengngina kpac kecdae. Ge yeni isoc mi ambesena. Yeni dumbengnginau witic kpena kemeu, imohai yoacga modacgecde nga witiha kpacngo geac wegenac naric mi hagecde.”

Ngicngac Anutu ngadehema mangana megecdeac ayemmeande, yeni ebic homac meficgema mayunuude. Nga ngicngac yeni KEBU negenserima kecgec KEBUNGO yoac dedzege amma imoc modarude. Nga yeac faka imocngo orongyunuude.
O ngicngac dindingac, ngeni sasawango sogaima KEBU dengerebisia. Ngicwiac herenginau ikoc nga hamangec mong mi fede, ngeni sasawango sogaima dendzerenggema arohobisia.
